finding: ADES prints no operating-profit subtotal, yet FY2023-FY2025 OPINC_REP carry provenance D. ADES operating income uses three different bases: (a) FY2023-25 = gross profit - G&A only (the XBRL tag), which leaves out end-of-service benefits, share-based pay, other income/expense, bargain gains and acquisition costs; (b) FY2022 = PBT + finance costs - finance income, which includes the 422.3m bargain purchase gain and the 236.6m receivables impairment; (c) 9M = PBT + net finance costs. FY and 9M margins are therefore not comparable. Separately, FY2022 IMPAIR_CF (236.6) is a trade-receivable provision added back to EBITDA, unlike other companies, and FY2025 omits the PP&E impairment add-back of 28.1m.
expected: One basis for all periods, e.g. PBT + net finance costs: FY2023 1,240.635; FY2024 1,774.761; FY2025 1,985.464 (provenance C)
evidence_source_page: 2382_ADES/2025_Annual_filed2026-03-29.pdf p10 (no operating profit line), p13 (impairment 28,123); 2024_Annual_filed2025-03-04.pdf p8; 2023_Annual_filed2024-03-07.pdf p60
recommendation: Apply the 9M definition to every period, label it C, and exclude receivable provisions from the EBITDA add-backs.
